reading.rtitle: Sucafina Brazil -- Status Note Before the Midpoint Meeting
paras: Hello team. Before our meeting on Friday, here is the status. Right now Carlos is preparing the files for the next audit, and Ana is updating the records in the system. There are twelve producers in our group, and there are two new properties in the region. The total is ninety-four hectares.

Last month Carlos visited three farms. He spoke with the producers and he saw the storage areas. There was no record for one processing unit, and there were two small gaps in the training list. This is our main concern, but it is not a critical finding. The evidence is in his report.

Now the plan. Carlos is going to send the corrective action to the producer on Monday. This is our top priority. And remember: the documents are requested every year, and the certificate is renewed in December. Our progress is good -- eighty percent of the actions are closed.
reading.source: Emma, Sustainability Coordinator -- internal note, A1 reading

bank.label: Useful status meeting lines
items: Right now I am preparing the files for the audit.
There are twelve producers and two new properties.
Last week I visited the farm and I spoke with the producer.
There was no record for the processing unit.
I am going to send the corrective action on Monday.

listenings.text: This is how I prepare for a status meeting. First I check the numbers. How many producers are in the group? How many farms are audited this year? Then I write two lines about the work now: what I am doing, and what my team is doing. After that I write what happened on the last visit: what I saw, what I recorded, and where there was a gap. I always say my concern early, and I always bring the evidence. At the end I say the plan: what I am going to do, and when.

Hi Carlos, this is Emma. I read your status note, and I have some feedback for you. First, the good news: your numbers are clear and your note arrived on time. Thank you. Second, one small point for Friday. Do not start with the problem. Start with the progress, then the concern, then the plan. It is easier for the group. And one more thing. When you talk about a gap, always say the corrective action in the same sentence. That is what the auditors do. See you on Friday, Carlos. Good work.

extra_audio.text: First, the numbers: there are twelve producers in the group. Then the work now: right now I am preparing the files for the next audit. Next, the last visit: last month I visited three farms and I spoke with the producers. After that, the problem: there was no record for one processing unit. Finally, the plan: I am going to send the corrective action on Monday.
